claims.exactWording: Choose how Blanc blocks ads and trackers.
Customizable filter lists, advanced settings and a request logger for regular tabs.
Private tabs use Blanc Blocker. Changing blockers requires a restart. Site settings stay separate.

artwork.export: Shared copper/bronze master, recolored with the built-in imagegen tool at the owner’s request. Sharp: trim threshold 8, resize contain 960×960 with transparent padding, WebP quality 90 / alphaQuality 100 / effort 6. Export preserves the edited master’s colors.
artwork.license: Reserved Blanc product identity per ASSET-LICENSE.md. Horizon Shield is Blanc artwork, not the uBlock Origin logo.

model.geometry: Closed bronze relief mesh. Front and back use identical approved artwork/UVs and matching relief turned 180 degrees; solid beveled walls join them. Silhouette is alpha-traced with subpixel edge smoothing.
model.ownerDirection: October 3: make the shield solid 3D; use the same front artwork on the back; remove the visible caption; close all side surfaces.

recolor.direction: Match the shield everywhere in the app and website to the copper/bronze tones of the original Sunrise sun; reduce the bright yellow-gold cast.

appArtworkDependency.deliveryOrder: Merge app-only PR #502 into main; include its monochrome native Island icon in the next verified public app release; then reconcile release evidence, retarget website PR #491 to main, merge and deploy the website. islandIcon.treatment: Monochrome inline SVG with currentColor and three curved layers. The website hero extracts the exact native SVG and styles. Bronze texture is reserved for the large Privacy illustration.
